tipContents.cn: 酸液源石虫·α<@gd.key>抵达漂浮源石处会自爆造成大量伤害</>，需要小心，其死亡时会<@gd.key>吸附周围的敌人</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
tipContents.en: Careful! When Acid Originium Slug α <@gd.key>reaches the floating Originium, it explodes to deal massive DMG</>. When killed, the creature also <@gd.key>pulls in nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

tipContents.cn: 善用<@gd.key>闪避</>，躲开敌人的强力攻击。
tipContents.en: <@gd.key>Dodge</> smartly to evade powerful enemy attacks.

tipContents.cn: 引诱斧甲兽撞击酸液源石虫，使酸液源石虫进入<@gd.key>失衡状态</>后，再利用<@gd.key>处决伤害</>或者斧甲兽的撞击击败酸液源石虫。
tipContents.en: Position yourself so that the Axe Armorbeast rams and applies <@gd.key>Staggered</> on the Acid Originium Slug. Use <@gd.key>Finisher DMG</> and/or the Axe Armorbeast's ramming to defeat the Acid Originium Slug.
